title: What the Monsters Remember (Fantasy)
prompt: Write a short fantasy short story (1500-2500 words) about a village's designated monster hunter, who has secretly been sparing every monster she's sent to kill for years -- faking evidence of each 'kill' and quietly relocating the monster instead. The story begins the day a monster she spared long ago walks calmly into the village square in broad daylight and asks for her by name, in front of everyone. Give her a real dilemma to navigate and a satisfying end. Save it as story.md with a title as the very first line.

verify.description: Mechanical gates only (existence, length, required premise elements, no leaked tokens) -- NOT a judgment of narrative quality. See benchmark/README.md's Evaluation methodology section.
